Script 1 · “Willpower”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here’s why so many good plans are gone by Thursday.”

Body

“It’s rarely about knowing what to do. Most of us already know. Willpower is a great starter and a terrible plan. What carries you on the hard days is your mindset and a routine small enough to keep. That part can be learned.”

CTA

“I’m teaching it live in a 60-minute masterclass. It’s $17, the replay is included. Tap Sign up to grab your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera, same warm setup as your reels. On-screen text: “Willpower isn’t the plan.”

Script 2 · “All or nothing”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“One off day doesn’t have to become an off month.”

Body

“A lot of people run on all or nothing. Perfect week, then one slip, then nothing. What changes that isn’t a stricter plan. It’s what you tell yourself on the day it slips, and having a simple way back in.”

CTA

“In the Abundant Mindset Masterclass I’ll show you how. Live, 60 minutes, $17. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a slide of the “way back in” steps.

Script 3 · “The 10-minute reset”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“This 10-minute morning habit changes how the whole day feels.”

Body

“It’s not a two-hour routine. It’s three questions and one intention, before the to-do list takes over. Small, repeatable, and it makes room for you in a full life.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it in my live masterclass. Seats are $17. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: morning light, coffee in hand, talking to camera. On-screen text: “10 minutes.”
